prices.generate_motion: 1 per second of requested duration, so 1-60 credits for a 1-60s clip; flat in the 4 samples it produces
prices.generate_motion_from_video: 1 per second of footage extracted, rounded up - the whole video unless trimStartSeconds/trimDurationSeconds narrow it

structuredContent.nextSteps: These prices are this server's copy and the charge is computed by PINOC at submit; treat them as an estimate. Taking a library clip is always free, so try list_motion_library before spending anything.
